# CSS Guidelines

## General Principles
- Keep the UI clean, minimal, and easy to read
- Prefer simple layouts over complex ones
- Use consistent spacing, colors, and typography
- Avoid unnecessary visual clutter

## Layout & Spacing
- Use consistent padding and margin (e.g. 8px grid system)
- Prefer flexbox or grid for layouts
- Keep enough whitespace between elements

## Components Styling

### Cards / Containers
- Use rounded corners (`border-radius: 8px` or `12px`)
- Add subtle shadows:
  - `box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- Use light background colors (e.g. white or light gray)

### Buttons
- Rounded corners (`border-radius: 6px`)
- Clear hover states
- Use primary color for main actions
- Secondary buttons should be more subtle

### Inputs
- Rounded edges
- Clear focus state (e.g. border highlight)
- Enough padding for readability

## Colors
- Use a small, consistent color palette
- Prefer neutral tones (white, gray, soft colors)
- Use one primary accent color

## Typography
- Use a clean, modern font (e.g. sans-serif)
- Ensure good contrast between text and background
- Use clear hierarchy (headings, body text)

## Interactions
- Add smooth transitions:
  - `transition: all 0.2s ease`
- Provide visual feedback on hover/click
- Keep animations subtle and fast

## Responsiveness
- Design mobile-first
- Ensure layout works on all screen sizes
- Avoid fixed widths where possible

## Do NOT
- Do not use overly bright or clashing colors
- Do not add heavy shadows or excessive effects
- Do not overcrowd the UI

## Always use:
- rounded corners
- subtle shadows
- minimalistic design
- soft color palette
